title: Implement winning charpoly dispatch
description:

Per AskUserQuestion 2026-05-07: 7 of 8 charpoly target rows close on this issue's path with the post-d1dd266c+siblings packed cyclic_decomposition / chain_polys / Barrett-table-cache work integrated. `GF(251)/n=256` charpoly remains at 3.18x of fflas (was 9.58x at d1dd266c open) — sibling task `5a3dbd5b` reduced the gap by 3x via canonical-byte chain_polys arithmetic, but the residual constant-factor gap requires a bespoke register-scheduled small-prime AVX2 kernel in `gf2-kernels-simd`. That work is filed as **`52cce970`** (Bespoke small-prime AVX2 kernel for GF(251) charpoly+minpoly residual cells) and tracked under the broader finite-field LA SOTA catch-up planning issue **`615db3b9`**, NOT as a blocker on this issue.

Re-escalation threshold: re-evaluate the GF(251)/n=256 charpoly cell when `52cce970` closes.

Dispatch state confirmed by integrated post-sibling scorecard at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-07-d1dd266c-minpoly-tuning.md` § 3.2:
- KG_DISPATCH_MIN_N = usize::MAX in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/charpoly.rs:231` (cubic always wins per 4a59d1f9 reassessment).
- charpoly_dispatch routes to charpoly_cubic for all finite n.
